message.text:
Identifying which database tables are affected by DeleteMemo, either directly or through explicit cascade code.

Store.DeleteMemo deletes memo_relation and attachments before removing the memo row. DeleteAttachment and recursive comment deletion may add further tables. Reactions, inbox, and memo_share are also being checked for cascade deletions.
Tracing the full DeleteMemo flow for all tables touched directly or via explicit cascade code.

Determining whether "DeleteMemo" refers to Store.DeleteMemo or the broader API flow.

Store.DeleteMemo directly deletes rows from memo, memo_relation, and attachment. The API path recursively deletes comment memos through this same store method. No other cascades or deletions are triggered.

Checking whether memo_share, reaction, or inbox tables are affected by DeleteMemo. User_delete.go was ruled out because it handles DeleteUser instead.

Identifying which database tables are directly affected or impacted by explicit cascade logic within Store.DeleteMemo.

Store.DeleteMemo directly affects three tables: memo_relation, attachment, and memo. The API DeleteMemo recursively calls Store.DeleteMemo on comment memos first, then on the parent memo, so those same three tables are still the ones touched.

Other tables such as reaction, memo_share, inbox, and user are unaffected by Store.DeleteMemo. DeleteAttachment only removes records from the attachment table and does not touch any database table.
